title: మారీచుణ్ణి ప్రాణాలతో వదిలిన రాముడు | రామాయణం భాగం 7
topic: Maricha and Subahu at Siddhashrama (Valmiki Ramayana 1.29.29–1.30.26; teaser 1.31.9)
edition: vulgate (southern recension), sa.wikisource; verse numbers cross-checked on valmikiramayan.net

sources.edition: vulgate (valmikiramayan.net; sa.wikisource sarga 29 numbering is broken)
sources.note: Ep06 teaser: obstructing rakshasas come to this hermitage; here they must be killed (hook)
the princes ask the sage to begin; Vishvamitra enters the diksha (sacrificial vow) that day
the sages: guard for six nights from today, the sage is consecrated and keeps silence; the princes guard sleepless six days and nights
on the sixth day Rama tells Lakshmana to be alert and ready; the altar fire blazes up
a great terrifying sound in the sky; like a rain cloud covering the sky, the two rakshasas rush in, working maya
Maricha and Subahu with their followers pour streams of blood; Rama sees the altar drenched
Rama: they will be scattered by the Manava weapon like clouds by wind; he looses the Manava at Maricha's chest; Maricha is hurled a full hundred yojanas into the surging ocean
on-screen verse 1.30.20: the Manava 'cold arrow' carries him off stunned but does not take his life

sources.edition: vulgate (sa.wikisource; valmikiramayan.net splits these two verses differently, same range)
sources.note: Agneya weapon at Subahu's chest, he falls; the Vayavya weapon kills the rest
all the obstructing rakshasas killed; sacrifice completed; Vishvamitra: my purpose is fulfilled, you made Siddhashrama true to its name
next morning the sages tell Rama of Janaka's sacrifice at Mithila and a wondrous bow; teaser verse 1.31.9: no god, gandharva, asura, rakshasa or man can string it
the bow of the great-souled king of Mithila (Next card: Janaka's bow)
